title: Pure Ashtra
summary: The pure Beyond the Brave Ashtra build with Audhumla, Compulsory Evacuation Device, its Synchro/Rank 7 Extra Deck toolbox, and generic staples. Every Level 7 Ashtra monster Special Summons itself from the hand by returning one of your Set cards to the hand, and every Ashtra Normal Trap can Special Summon itself as a Level 1 Tuner and immediately Synchro Summon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond (Field Spell) sends any number of Set cards you control to the GY to search that many Ashtra cards from the Deck, and bounces a card on the field whenever a card is Set.

Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra bounces a Set card you control to Special Summon itself from the hand, searches any non-Wyrm Ashtra monster, and Sets a Normal Trap from your GY when used as Synchro Material.
Yoa the Plague Ashtra bounces a Set card to Special Summon itself, Sets an Ashtra Spell/Trap directly from the Deck, and adjusts a monster's Level by 1 on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Opening: Mikumari or Yoa + Any Set Card
steps: Set any Spell/Trap, then return that Set card to your hand to Special Summon Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra and search Yoa the Plague Ashtra.

Set the card again, bounce it to Special Summon Yoa the Plague Ashtra, and use Yoa to Set Ashtra's Web, Ashtra's Howl or Ashtra's Domain from the Deck (triggering Ashtrashen to bounce a card if active).

On the opponent's turn, activate an Ashtra Trap to apply its disruption effect—or Special Summon it as a Level 1 Tuner and immediately Synchro Summon Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto (Level 8) or Ashtraja Susanoo (Level 9, using Yoa's Level modulation or two Trap Tuners).
Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra triggers as Synchro Material to re-Set the used Normal Trap (or Compulsory Evacuation Device / Infinite Impermanence) from the GY.

summary.title: Trap Tuners & Non-Engine Synergy
summary.text: Ashtra's Web (revives an Ashtra), Ashtra's Howl (destroys a monster) and Ashtra's Domain (negates a Spell/Trap while the opponent controls no Set cards) each have a second mode that Special Summons the Trap as a Level 1 Tuner and performs a Synchro Summon right away. Because Mikumari resets any Normal Trap from the GY when used as Synchro Material, generic Normal Traps like Compulsory Evacuation Device and Infinite Impermanence loop every turn alongside Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse, which trades Set cards for draws and shields your Set back row.

summary.title: Synchro & Rank 7 Toolbox
points: Ashtraya Mikumari-no-Mikoto (Level 8 Synchro) mills an Ashtra card to send any card on the field to the GY, and Sets a Normal Trap from the hand or GY when the opponent activates a monster effect.
Ashtraja Susanoo (Level 9 Synchro) banishes Traps from your GY to banish that many cards on the field, and recycles two Ashtra cards during the End Phase.

Graydle Dragon (Level 8, made with WATER Aqua Tuner Ashtra's Domain + WATER Mikumari) destroys 2 opposing cards on summon, Crystron Quariongandrax (Level 9, made with two Trap Tuners + a Level 7 Ashtra) banishes up to 3 monsters from the opponent's field and GY, and Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack bridges two Level 7 Ashtras.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Labrynth, Paleozoic and First Penguin hybrid variants are omitted in favor of the pure Ashtra list.

allow.Graydle Dragon: Extra Deck toolbox on the page: Ashtra's Domain plus Mikumari make two WATER materials, so it destroys two cards.
allow.Crystron Quariongandrax: Extra Deck toolbox on the page: two Trap Tuners plus a Level 7 Ashtra banish up to three monsters.
allow.Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack: Extra Deck toolbox on the page: Mikumari and Yoa are both Level 7.

main: Mikumari the Banisher Ashtra
Summons itself by returning a Set card; searches a non-Wyrm Ashtra; as Synchro Material, Sets a Normal Trap from the GY.
Yoa the Plague Ashtra
Summons itself the same way; Sets an Ashtra Spell/Trap from the Deck, and moves a Level on their turn.
Akasuna the Battle Ashtra
Summons itself the same way; sends a Trap to flip their monsters face-down, and Sets an Ashtra Trap at the End Phase.
Kuzuha the Hex Ashtra
Summons itself the same way; destroys a card for every two face-down cards, and Sets an Ashtra Trap from the GY.
Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
Generic WATER from the same set: trades your Set cards for draws and protects your face-down cards.
Ashtrashen - Gate to the Worlds Beyond
Field Spell: sends your Set cards to search that many Ashtra cards; bounces a card whenever a card is Set.
Ashtra's Web
Becomes a Level 1 Tuner and Synchro Summons, or revives an Ashtra.
Ashtra's Howl
Becomes a Level 1 Tuner and Synchro Summons, or destroys a monster.
Ashtra's Domain
Becomes a Level 1 WATER Tuner and Synchro Summons, or negates a Spell/Trap while they have nothing Set.
Compulsory Evacuation Device
Generic Normal Trap the page recommends: bounces a monster, and Mikumari Sets it again.
extra: Level 8: mills an Ashtra to send a card on the field to the GY; Sets a Trap when they use a monster effect.
Level 9: banishes a card for each Trap you banish from the GY; returns two Ashtra cards at the End Phase.
Level 8 for an Aqua Tuner: destroys a card per WATER material.
